title: On a Regular Basis
subtitle: 「定期地／經常地」，究竟是哪一種規律？
description: 「定期地／經常地」，究竟是哪一種規律？

words.note: 最直接、最自然的替換，表示某件事按固定或相對穩定的頻率發生。
words.example: Staff regularly review the safety procedures.
words.exampleZh: 員工會定期檢討安全程序。

exercises.original: The team meets on a regular basis to review progress.
exercises.zh: 團隊會定期開會檢討進度。

options.explanation: occasionally = occasionally 表示偶爾；本句是固定檢討進度。
randomly = randomly 表示沒有規律，和 regular basis 相反。
regularly = meets ... to review progress 表示反覆且有安排的會議，因此 regularly 最自然。
constantly = constantly 幾乎不停，會把會議頻率誇大。
daily = daily 只表示每天，而本句沒有指定每天。
repeatedly = repeatedly 只表示多次，不一定有固定安排。

exercises.original: The filters are replaced on a regular basis to maintain air quality.
exercises.zh: 濾網會定期更換，以維持空氣質素。

options.explanation: randomly = 維修不會隨機更換。
occasionally = 可能頻率太低，未能表達固定保養。
constantly = 不會不停更換濾網。
regularly = maintenance context 表示按穩定頻率執行，regularly 最精確。
daily = 未有每天更換的線索。
rarely = rarely 表示很少，和 regular basis 相反。

exercises.original: She exercises on a regular basis to improve her fitness.
exercises.zh: 她定期運動以改善體能。

options.explanation: occasionally = 太低頻，不符合穩定習慣。
randomly = 運動安排沒有規律的意思會改變。
constantly = 不可能持續不停運動。
once = 只表示一次。
regularly = 長期穩定的 exercise habit 最自然用 regularly。
repeatedly = 可表示多次，但不如 regularly 表達習慣性規律。

words.note: 強調某件事已成為日常或標準程序的一部分，常見於工作、醫療和行政語境。
words.example: The equipment is routinely inspected before use.
words.exampleZh: 設備在使用前會例行檢查。

exercises.original: The laboratory checks all safety equipment on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 實驗室會例行檢查所有安全設備。

options.explanation: randomly = 安全檢查不是隨機進行。
occasionally = 例行檢查比偶爾檢查更穩定。
constantly = 不需要不停檢查。
routinely = safety checks 已成為標準程序，所以 routinely 比一般 frequently 更精確。
rarely = 和 safety routine 相反。
unexpectedly = 表示出乎意料，不合標準程序。

exercises.original: Doctors screen patients for this condition on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 醫生會例行為病人篩查這種疾病。

options.explanation: occasionally = 不能表達標準醫療流程。
randomly = 醫療篩查不應隨機無規律進行。
constantly = 不是連續不斷篩查。
rarely = 和 routine screening 相反。
routinely = medical screening 作為標準流程時，routinely 很自然。
suddenly = 表示突然，完全不合。

exercises.original: The company backs up customer records on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 公司會例行備份客戶紀錄。

options.explanation: randomly = backup 應有規律。
occasionally = 不足以表達制度化流程。
constantly = 未必實時連續備份。
rarely = 不合資料管理慣例。
accidentally = 表示意外執行，完全不合。
routinely = 如果 backup 已納入標準工作流程，routinely 最精確。

words.note: 表示某事發生很多次，但未必按照固定時間表；和 on a regular basis 接近，但更強調次數多而不是規律性。
words.example: The team meets frequently during the final stage of the project.
words.exampleZh: 團隊在項目最後階段會頻繁開會。

exercises.original: During the final week, the team met on a regular basis to resolve problems quickly.
exercises.zh: 最後一週，團隊頻繁開會以迅速解決問題。

options.explanation: rarely = 和 final-week high activity 相反。
occasionally = 頻率不足。
randomly = 會議雖多但不表示無規律。
constantly = 太強，表示幾乎不停開會。
frequently = during the final week + rapid problem solving 表示次數很多，因此 frequently 最自然。
annually = 每年一次完全不合一週內多次。

exercises.original: She travels to the regional office on a regular basis during the busy season.
exercises.zh: 旺季期間她經常前往區域辦公室。

options.explanation: rarely = 和 busy season 相反。
randomly = 不是無規律亂去。
constantly = 過度誇張。
yearly = 旺季期間通常不只是每年一次。
once = 完全不合。
frequently = 句子重點是 busy season 中發生很多次，frequently 很貼切。

exercises.original: The website is updated on a regular basis when major events are taking place.
exercises.zh: 有重大活動時，網站會頻繁更新。

options.explanation: frequently = 重大活動期間強調更新次數多，所以 frequently 比固定間隔說法更合適。
occasionally = 重大活動期間更新應較密集。
randomly = 更新不是隨機。
constantly = 未必連續每一刻更新。
rarely = 相反。
monthly = 重大活動期間未必只每月更新。

words.note: 強調某行為長期穩定地重複出現，重點是持續性和一致性，而不一定是固定時間間隔。
words.example: She consistently arrives early for training.
words.exampleZh: 她一向都會提早到達訓練場地。

exercises.original: She performs well on a regular basis, not just in major competitions.
exercises.zh: 她一直都有穩定好表現，而不只是大型比賽時。

options.explanation: occasionally = 和 not just in major competitions 的穩定表現不符。
randomly = 不能表達一貫性。
constantly = 會變成每一刻都在表現，不自然。
rarely = 相反。
periodically = 只表示隔段時間，不表示每次表現都穩定。
consistently = 本句重點不是時間表，而是長期表現一貫，因此 consistently 最精確。

exercises.original: The machine has produced accurate readings on a regular basis for several months.
exercises.zh: 這部機器幾個月來一直穩定產生準確讀數。

options.explanation: consistently = for several months + accurate readings 強調持續一致，因此 consistently 最自然。
randomly = 準確度不是隨機。
occasionally = 不足以表達 several months 的穩定性。
constantly = 不表示機器必須無間斷運作。
rarely = 相反。
unexpectedly = 和穩定結果相反。

exercises.original: He arrives on time on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 他一向都準時到達。

options.explanation: occasionally = 只偶爾準時不足以表達穩定習慣。
consistently = 句子重點是每次表現的一致性，因此 consistently 很精確。
randomly = 到達時間若 random 就不是穩定準時。
rarely = 和原意相反。
constantly = 不能表示每一刻都在到達。
periodically = 不表示每次都準時。

words.note: 較正式，表示某事隔一段時間重複發生，常用於檢查、更新、評估或維修。
words.example: The system is periodically updated to improve security.
words.exampleZh: 系統會定期更新，以改善安全性。

exercises.original: The policy is reviewed on a regular basis to ensure it remains effective.
exercises.zh: 政策會定期檢討，以確保仍然有效。

options.explanation: periodically = 政策隔一段時間重複 review，正式語境最自然用 periodically。
constantly = 政策不會不停被檢討。
randomly = review 應有制度安排。
rarely = 不足以表達 regular review。
suddenly = 不是突然發生。
once = 只檢討一次不合。

exercises.original: The sensors are calibrated on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 感應器會定期校準。

options.explanation: randomly = 校準不是無規律。
periodically = technical maintenance 每隔一段時間進行，periodically 最精確。
constantly = 不需要持續校準。
occasionally = 語氣偏隨意，未必是正式 maintenance cycle。
never = 完全相反。
accidentally = 不合技術程序。

exercises.original: The committee reassesses the programme on a regular basis as conditions change.
exercises.zh: 委員會會隨情況變化定期重新評估計劃。

options.explanation: constantly = 不表示連續不停重新評估。
randomly = reassessment 應有安排。
periodically = formal reassessment 隔段時間反覆進行，periodically 很自然。
rarely = 和 regular basis 不符。
immediately = 只表示立即，不表示反覆。
once = 沒有重複意味。

words.note: 強調每次發生之間的時間間隔相對固定，適合技術、醫療、測量和程序語境。
words.example: Samples were collected at regular intervals throughout the experiment.
words.exampleZh: 實驗期間按固定間隔收集樣本。

exercises.original: The nurse measured the patient's blood pressure on a regular basis throughout the night.
exercises.zh: 護士整晚按固定間隔量度病人的血壓。
exercises.upgrade: at regular intervals · 按固定間隔；定時

options.explanation: randomly = 醫療監測不會隨機無計劃進行。
at regular intervals = throughout the night + repeated measurements 表示固定時間間隔，因此答案最精確。
occasionally = 太模糊，未表達固定間隔。
constantly = 血壓不是每一刻連續手動量度。
once = 和 throughout the night 不符。
rarely = 頻率過低。

exercises.original: Samples were collected on a regular basis during the six-hour test.
exercises.zh: 六小時測試期間按固定間隔收集樣本。
exercises.upgrade: at regular intervals · 按固定間隔；定時

options.explanation: randomly = 若 random sampling 需要明說；本句是 regular basis。
constantly = 採樣不是無間斷。
at regular intervals = 實驗中強調固定採樣間隔，at regular intervals 最自然。
occasionally = 未能表達實驗時間間隔的規律。
rarely = 不合 repeated sampling。
once = 和 samples 複數及 six-hour test 不符。

exercises.original: The alarm sounded on a regular basis as part of the test sequence.
exercises.zh: 警報在測試程序中按固定間隔響起。
exercises.upgrade: at regular intervals · 按固定間隔；定時

options.explanation: randomly = test sequence 不是隨機。
constantly = 如果一直響，就沒有 intervals。
occasionally = 太不精確。
at regular intervals = test sequence 明確表示預設節奏，因此 at regular intervals 很精確。
unexpectedly = 和 planned test sequence 相反。
rarely = 未必符合 sequence。

words.note: 較正式，表示某件事會持續重複發生，常用於付款、會議、任務或服務安排。
words.example: The fee is charged on a recurring basis.
words.exampleZh: 這項費用會定期重複收取。

exercises.original: The membership fee is charged on a regular basis until the account is cancelled.
exercises.zh: 會員費會定期重複收取，直至帳戶取消。
exercises.upgrade: on a recurring basis · 反覆定期地；週期性地

options.explanation: once = 只收一次，和 until cancelled 不符。
randomly = 付款不應隨機。
on a recurring basis = until the account is cancelled 表示收費會持續重複，因此 on a recurring basis 最精確。
occasionally = 訂閱費通常有固定重複安排。
constantly = 不會每一刻扣款。
unexpectedly = 定期費用不應是意外收費。

exercises.original: The consultant visits the office on a regular basis under the service agreement.
exercises.zh: 顧問按服務協議定期到訪辦公室。
exercises.upgrade: on a recurring basis · 反覆定期地；週期性地

options.explanation: randomly = service agreement 通常規定安排，不是隨機。
once = 沒有 recurring 意思。
rarely = 未能表達持續安排。
on a recurring basis = under the service agreement 表示持續重複安排，因此這個正式說法很自然。
constantly = 不可能不停到訪。
accidentally = 完全不合合約安排。

exercises.original: Reports are sent to clients on a regular basis rather than only when problems occur.
exercises.zh: 報告會定期發給客戶，而不是只在出問題時才發送。
exercises.upgrade: on a recurring basis · 反覆定期地；週期性地

options.explanation: occasionally = rather than only when problems occur 表示已有固定持續安排。
randomly = 不合客戶報告制度。
once = 不是一次性。
constantly = 過強。
on a recurring basis = 報告不是事件觸發，而是持續週期性發送，因此 on a recurring basis 最合適。
unexpectedly = 不合。

words.note: 較正式，表示某件事因為已成為標準慣例而固定執行。
words.example: Employees are asked to back up important files as a matter of routine.
words.exampleZh: 員工按慣例需要備份重要檔案。

exercises.original: The staff check emergency exits on a regular basis before large events.
exercises.zh: 員工按例行程序在大型活動前檢查緊急出口。
exercises.upgrade: as a matter of routine · 作為例行程序；按慣例

options.explanation: randomly = 安全檢查不是隨機。
occasionally = 無法表達標準程序。
constantly = 不需要不停檢查出口。
as a matter of routine = 如果這項檢查已成為標準慣例，as a matter of routine 最精確。
rarely = 與安全慣例相反。
unexpectedly = 活動前檢查是預定程序。

exercises.original: Important files are copied to a secure server on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 重要檔案按慣例會複製到安全伺服器。
exercises.upgrade: as a matter of routine · 作為例行程序；按慣例

options.explanation: randomly = backup 不應隨機。
occasionally = 不足以表達制度化流程。
constantly = 未必是 continuous backup。
rarely = 和安全做法相反。
as a matter of routine = 資料備份屬標準工作流程時，可自然說 as a matter of routine。
accidentally = 不合。

exercises.original: Visitors' identification is checked on a regular basis at the entrance.
exercises.zh: 訪客身分證明在入口處會按例行程序檢查。
exercises.upgrade: as a matter of routine · 作為例行程序；按慣例

options.explanation: randomly = 如果只抽查才可能 random；本句說的是 regular basis。
rarely = 不合 entrance procedure。
occasionally = 不能表達標準做法。
unexpectedly = 訪客應預期這項程序。
once = 不是只檢查某一個人一次的整體制度。
as a matter of routine = 入口身份核對作為標準 procedure，as a matter of routine 很自然。

words.note: 表示某人因長期習慣而反覆做某事，通常用於人的行為；有時帶輕微負面語感。
words.example: He habitually checks his phone during meals.
words.exampleZh: 他習慣在用餐時查看手機。

exercises.original: He checks his phone on a regular basis during meals.
exercises.zh: 他習慣在用餐期間查看手機。

options.explanation: periodically = 只表示隔段時間，沒有個人習慣意味。
randomly = 不表示固定習慣。
occasionally = 頻率太低，不能表達 habit。
constantly = 可能過度誇張成一直查看。
habitually = 重複行為已成為個人習慣，因此 habitually 最精確。
unexpectedly = 完全不合。

exercises.original: She arrives late on a regular basis despite repeated warnings.
exercises.zh: 儘管多次被警告，她仍習慣性遲到。

options.explanation: occasionally = 如果只是偶爾，repeated warnings 的語境較不匹配。
randomly = 遲到不是隨機模式的重點。
periodically = 過於中性，未表達個人壞習慣。
constantly = 不能說每一刻都在遲到。
rarely = 和 repeated warnings 相反。
habitually = despite repeated warnings 顯示行為已成習慣，habitually 很自然。

exercises.original: He leaves tasks until the last minute on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 他習慣把工作拖到最後一刻。

options.explanation: habitually = 反覆拖延已成穩定個人習慣，因此 habitually 最精確。
randomly = 不表示慣性模式。
occasionally = 不足以形成 habitually 的強度。
periodically = 只是週期性，不表示個人慣性。
constantly = 不自然，因為這是每項 task 的習慣模式。
once = 完全不合。

words.note: 表示某件事多次發生，重點是重複次數，不一定有固定規律或時間間隔。

exercises.original: The system failed on a regular basis during the stress test.
exercises.zh: 系統在壓力測試中反覆出現故障。

options.explanation: periodically = 會暗示較有規律的時間間隔，但本句只需表達多次故障。
randomly = 可能描述模式，但不表示次數很多。
occasionally = 頻率太低。
constantly = 可能誇大成無間斷故障。
once = 與 repeated failures 相反。
repeatedly = stress test 中重點是 failure 多次發生，而非固定時間表，因此 repeatedly 最自然。

exercises.original: The same error appeared on a regular basis despite several fixes.
exercises.zh: 儘管已多次修正，同一錯誤仍反覆出現。

options.explanation: repeatedly = despite several fixes 表示問題一再出現，所以 repeatedly 最精確。
occasionally = 不能表達 several fixes 後仍多次出現的強度。
randomly = 不一定是無規律的。
periodically = 會偏向週期性，不是此句核心。
once = 完全不合。
rarely = 和 repeated problem 相反。

exercises.original: The warning was ignored on a regular basis by the same group of users.
exercises.zh: 同一群使用者一再忽視這項警告。

options.explanation: periodically = 太中性，沒有『一再』的強度。
repeatedly = 同一群人多次忽視警告，重點是重複發生，因此 repeatedly 最自然。
occasionally = 頻率不足。
randomly = 不能表達 persistent recurrence。
constantly = 過強，像每一刻都在忽視。
once = 相反。

words.note: 和 on a regular basis 很接近，尤其適合工作流程、檢查和行政程序，強調它屬於日常或固定流程。
words.example: The records are checked on a routine basis.
words.exampleZh: 這些紀錄會按例行安排檢查。

exercises.original: The records are reviewed on a regular basis by the compliance team.
exercises.zh: 合規團隊會按例行安排檢查紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: on a routine basis · 按例行安排；定期地

options.explanation: on a routine basis = 正式工作流程中的定期審查，可自然用 on a routine basis。
randomly = compliance review 不應隨機無規律。
occasionally = 不足以表達制度化檢查。
constantly = 不會不停 review。
rarely = 和 compliance routine 相反。
unexpectedly = 不是臨時突發。

exercises.original: Maintenance staff inspect the lifts on a regular basis.
exercises.zh: 維修人員會按例行安排檢查升降機。
exercises.upgrade: on a routine basis · 按例行安排；定期地

options.explanation: randomly = 維修檢查需要規劃。
on a routine basis = lift inspection 是標準 maintenance duty，因此 on a routine basis 很精確。
occasionally = 太隨意，未表達標準保養安排。
constantly = 不需無間斷檢查。
rarely = 和 maintenance duty 相反。
accidentally = 完全不合。

exercises.original: The data is audited on a regular basis to identify reporting errors.
exercises.zh: 數據會按例行安排審核，以找出報告錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: on a routine basis · 按例行安排；定期地

options.explanation: randomly = audit 通常有制度安排。
occasionally = 不足以表達 standard control。
on a routine basis = 標準化、持續重複的 audit process 最自然用 on a routine basis。
constantly = 不表示 continuous auditing。
once = 不合持續監控。
rarely = 和 error-control purpose 不符。

falseSynonyms.zh: 不斷地不等於定期地 constantly 強調幾乎持續不停；on a regular basis 則表示反覆發生，但中間可以有間隔。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A task can happen regularly without happening constantly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偶爾不等於定期 occasionally 表示有時發生、頻率不高；通常比 on a regular basis 稀疏得多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Occasional events happen from time to time, not necessarily on a regular schedule.

falseSynonyms.zh: 隨機地不等於有規律地 randomly 表示沒有固定模式或預定規律，和 regular 的核心概念相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Random events do not follow a regular pattern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 每天不等於所有定期情況 daily 只表示每天一次或每天發生；on a regular basis 的頻率可以是每週、每月或其他間隔。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Daily is one possible regular frequency, but regular does not always mean daily.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反覆不一定有固定規律 repeatedly 只表示多次發生；是否定期要看上下文。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something can happen repeatedly but at irregular times.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與副詞不同 regular 是形容詞；regularly 是副詞。句子需要修飾動詞時通常用 regularly。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They hold regular meetings. They meet regularly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與副詞不同 frequent 是形容詞；frequently 是副詞。兩者都表示頻繁，但詞性不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Frequent checks are useful. The equipment is checked frequently.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞／形容詞與副詞不同 routine 可作名詞或形容詞；routinely 是副詞，表示某事按慣例執行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A routine inspection happens regularly. The equipment is routinely inspected.
